endpoints_tested_and_blocked.method: full authenticated browser session navigation (redirected to drive.usercontent.google.com)

failure_mechanism.http_status: 200 OK on every attempt (no exception thrown, no redirect loop)
failure_mechanism.response_body: Google's own static HTML page, title 'Google Drive - Quota exceeded' / 'Le quota autorisé a été atteint'
failure_mechanism.message: Sorry, you can't view or download this file at this time. Too many users have viewed or downloaded this file recently... it may take up to 24 hours.
failure_mechanism.classification: application-level anonymous-download rate limit on Google Drive's own endpoint
failure_mechanism.not_a_permissions_problem: folder contents list without authentication, confirming the share itself is valid
failure_mechanism.response_bodies_near_identical_not_byte_: each exactly 2009 bytes, identical error text, but each embeds a different per-response CSP nonce, confirming 4 independently-generated server responses, not one cached error

quaternius_evidence_correction.technical_inspection_performed_on_quater: NONE — zero glTF/GLB/FBX bytes were ever received for any Quaternius file; only the 2D preview JPG above was decoded (dimensions/mode/format only)
quaternius_evidence_correction.why_insufficient_for_adopt_or_pilot: This lot's promotion rule requires real download, deterministic hash, and real technical inspection of the candidate asset itself. A marketing preview image is not the candidate asset and contains no mesh/rig/material/animation data.
quaternius_evidence_correction.why_remaining_candidates_stay_reference: The Google Drive quota mechanism was confirmed identically on 2 independently-tested packs. This plausibly generalizes to the rest of the Quaternius catalogue (every product page uses the same Drive-folder download pattern) but was not tested beyond these 2 packs, per this lot's own bounded-scope rule. Precise claim: '2 packs tested, both blocked by the same mechanism' — not 'entire catalogue confirmed inaccessible.'

final_verdicts.name: Poly Haven snow_02
final_verdicts.guardrail: ADOPT means licence-verified and approved as an available material asset. It does not mean the texture has already been integrated into the Drift runtime. Runtime integration remains PRE-30 work.

final_verdicts.name: Kenney Mini Characters
final_verdicts.guardrail: Authorized for skeleton, clip, retargeting, crowd-instancing and animation-architecture experiments. Not accepted as the final visual appearance of foreground Drift humans. No accepted masterframe or realism doctrine may be weakened to match its low-poly visual style.

final_verdicts.name: Kenney City Kit (Commercial)
final_verdicts.guardrail: Authorized for greybox, urban massing, background silhouettes and modular-assembly evaluation. Not automatically authorized as final foreground architecture. Generic asset-store recognizability must be removed or transformed before any final artistic adoption.

final_verdicts.name: Kenney Car Kit
final_verdicts.guardrail: Authorized for traffic hierarchy, wheel-node mechanics, background vehicles and secondary-motion evaluation. Never replaces or redefines the canonical sand safari 4x4. Not accepted as final foreground vehicle art.

final_verdicts.name: three.js Water.js / Sky.js
final_verdicts.guardrail: Technical seed only. Does not satisfy Drift's final ocean, wave, splash, weather or sky direction. Any copied or substantially adapted MIT source must preserve the applicable three.js copyright and permission notice.

accepted_rejections.name: Mixamo / Adobe
accepted_rejections.exact_scope: Rejected specifically for repository-bundled use where raw or converted character/animation content would be redistributed through the public GitHub repo (Adobe General Terms of Use §3.6). Not a claim that Mixamo is forbidden for every possible end-use project — scoped to MISWAY's own public-repository asset workflow.

accepted_rejections.name: Kenney Nature Kit
accepted_rejections.exact_scope: Rejected as a final visual/PBR nature source for Drift — unlit, textureless, low-poly register conflicts with the accepted masterframes and Realism Bible. Must not silently return during PRE-30 as final environment art; existing in-repo Vegetation/Terrain ADOPT system remains the actual answer.

Currently proposed as an unmodified import, so no additional notice file is required today; recorded for a future fork/rewrite scenario.
